description: This file defines a class Smarty_Internal_Method_RegisterFilter which implements methods related to registering filters in Smarty templating system, including validation and internal naming of filters.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_RegisterFilter
classes.description: Implements filter registration, validation, and naming logic for Smarty templates.

methods.name: registerFilter
methods.description: Registers a filter function of a specified type ('pre', 'post', 'output', 'variable') in Smarty, with validation and optional naming.

methods.name: _getFilterName
methods.description: Generates an internal name for a filter based on its callback.

methods.name: _checkFilterType
methods.description: Validates that the provided filter type is one of the accepted types.
